KNOWLEDGE IS PART OF PROTECTION

Clear questions.
Considered answers.

Explore common questions about working with Isak, planning a project and caring for your systems.

What can Isak Fire Protection help with?

The team supports commercial, industrial and residential properties across nine fire protection disciplines. Explore the service directory, then contact Isak to confirm availability for your property.

Which locations do you serve?

The website lists Chicago, Toronto, Detroit, Dayton, Indianapolis and Milwaukee, serving Illinois, Ontario, Michigan, Ohio, Indiana and Wisconsin. Confirm the service scope for your address with the local team.

How do I request an estimate?

Call (312) 445-7787 or email sales@isakfire.com. You can also use the guided quote planner to prepare your project details and open an email draft for review.

What are your office hours?

Published office hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM. Contact the team during business hours for general inquiries and service scheduling.

How often should my systems be inspected?

Inspection and testing schedules vary by system, component, adopted code, manufacturer and local authority. Ask Isak to review the requirements that apply to your property and create an appropriate schedule.

What is NFPA 25?

NFPA 25 addresses inspection, testing and maintenance of water-based fire protection systems. The applicable edition and local requirements should be confirmed with the authority having jurisdiction and your service professional.

What happens when an inspection finds a deficiency?

Isak documents findings and can discuss corrective work. The required response and timing depend on the deficiency and local requirements. Ask your service team to explain the report and the next steps for your property.

How long will an inspection take?

The scope depends on the building, system size, number of devices and access. Discuss the schedule and operational considerations with the team before the visit.

Will I receive inspection records?

Isak's published service information includes inspection reports and certificates. Confirm the records included in your scope so your property team knows what to expect.

Do you work on new construction and retrofits?

Yes. Isak describes support for new construction, existing-building retrofits, system expansions and tenant improvements, including coordination with architects and general contractors.

How is an installation schedule determined?

Building size, system complexity, permitting and access all affect the schedule. Isak can review your project and establish a plan before work begins.

Can work be coordinated around business operations?

Discuss occupied-building requirements early. Depending on the project, phased work and agreed access windows may help reduce disruption; the team will confirm what is practical and safe.

Do you coordinate permits and local authorities?

Isak's website describes permitting, plan review submissions and coordination with the authority having jurisdiction as part of its project services. Confirm those responsibilities in your proposal.

When should kitchen suppression be serviced?

Service intervals depend on the system, manufacturer, applicable requirements and local authority. Ask the team to confirm the schedule for your kitchen and keep the service records available.

What if I move or add cooking equipment?

Have the suppression coverage reviewed before changing the cooking line. Appliance positions and equipment changes can affect system suitability and nozzle coverage.

What does UL 300 refer to?

UL 300 is a fire-test standard for systems protecting commercial cooking equipment. Ask your qualified system provider to explain how the equipment, listing and installation requirements apply to your kitchen.

Can I arrange a recurring service program?

Isak offers inspection and maintenance agreements. Discuss the systems included, service schedule, reporting, pricing and terms directly with the team.

How can I pay an invoice?

Use the Pay an invoice link to open Isak's existing Stripe payment page. Confirm your invoice details before paying. This design preview does not process payments.

Do you work with property management portfolios?

Yes. The published offering includes portfolio reporting, consolidated invoicing and account coordination for property and facility managers. Ask the team to confirm the services for your locations.

No matching questions. Try another term or contact our team.
